title: Boss Challenge: Sonar Mapper
summary: Use echoes to map the seabed and find a sunken ship: SONAR in action.

ib.note: Unit summative-style task: echo calculations and data interpretation (Criteria A and C)

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 10: Sound Waves: Characteristics and Applications (echo, ultrasound, SONAR)

objectives: I can use speed = distance ÷ time with echoes to calculate depth.

misconceptions: For echoes, distance = speed × time (without halving).
